data.content_ref: inline:Total widgets: 24. Total cost: $36. Justification: Suppose instead the total were not 24 widgets or $36. Then some pack would have to contain a number of widgets other than 6 or cost other than $9, contradicting the stated store terms. Since all 4 packs are identical to the stated unit, the totals are exactly 4×6=24 and 4×9=$36.
